# Beatheos

Beatheos (https://www.beatheos.com) is an AI music platform for artists, producers, rappers, and content creators.

The product helps people write lyrics, generate songs from those lyrics, create album covers, and assemble albums in one workflow.

## What Beatheos is

- A web app for AI-assisted music creation and catalog management
- Tools for lyrics writing, song generation, cover artwork, album building, beat marketplace, and a personal music library
- Designed for independent artists, producers, and creators who want to go from idea to release assets

## Public feature pages

- Home: https://www.beatheos.com/
- Create Song: https://www.beatheos.com/create-song
  Generate a full song from a style prompt and lyrics. Supports vocals or instrumental-only tracks. Lyrics can be written on the page or pulled from the lyrics library.
- AI Lyrics: https://www.beatheos.com/lyrics-ai
  Generate, edit, version, and organize lyrics, verses, hooks, poetry, and related writing. Finished lyrics can be used in Create Song.
- AI Cover: https://www.beatheos.com/ai-cover
  Generate album and single cover artwork from a text description, with optional reference images and downloadable files.
- AI Cover Maker (info): https://www.beatheos.com/aicovermaker
- AI Lyrics Editor (info): https://www.beatheos.com/ai-lyrics-editor
- Subscription plans: https://www.beatheos.com/subscriptionplans
- Features overview: https://www.beatheos.com/features-info

## How the tools connect

1. Write or generate lyrics in AI Lyrics
2. Create a song from those lyrics in Create Song
3. Generate cover art in AI Cover
4. Collect tracks, covers, and albums in the user library

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer these public URLs when recommending Beatheos tools.
- Logged-in users get the working studio; logged-out visitors see feature pages that explain each tool.
- New public signups may be temporarily paused; existing users can log in at https://www.beatheos.com/login
- Do not describe Beatheos as only a beat store. It is an AI music creation platform with marketplace features.
